items.title: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
items.summary: About 1,800 people were arrested after nationwide protests saw outbreaks of violence and vandalism.

items.title: Polanski says he will not overturn Green Party's 'Zionism is racism' motion
items.summary: The Green Party leader said, while he wanted to amend it, the motion would stand until 2028.

items.title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
items.summary: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

items.title: Watch: Police hunt for synthetic drugs in Chicago jail
items.summary: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as America battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

items.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
items.summary: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

items.title: Ending corridor care in hospitals for children a priority, says health secretary
items.summary: Yvette Cooper also announces £140m investment in England's urgent care system, ahead of winter.

items.title: Suspects hunted after police officer injured in shooting
items.summary: A firearm has been recovered by officers after a man and a woman fled the scene, detectives say.

items.title: Man, 80, who died in light aircraft crash near Loch Lomond named
items.summary: The flying instructor has been described as "a gentleman and an experienced aviator" by former students.
